scope: Existing verified predictions, fitted heads, cached representations and auxiliary evidence; no fitting, encoder execution, protected query or submission.
target_identity: Original competition ZIP test.csv and sample_submission.csv; exactly 209 test IDs
current_system: Existing locked all-826 emotion2vec logistic classifier plus unchanged certified retrieval override

fixed_pair_recipe.name: FIXED_50_50_PRIMARY_CV5_HEADMEAN_V1
fixed_pair_recipe.emotion2vec: Uniform mean of five existing ordinary V-B outer emotion2vec_base heads on verified cached test embeddings
fixed_pair_recipe.xlsr: Uniform mean of five existing ordinary V-B outer xls_r_300m heads on verified cached test embeddings
fixed_pair_recipe.decision: argmax in fixed class order, followed by unchanged certified 78-row retrieval override
fixed_pair_recipe.routing: None; all 209 rows receive the same five-head, equal-family probability recipe
fixed_pair_recipe.status: Explicit cached-head candidate implementation; not an all-826 XLS-R refit and not an imported historical test-probability artifact
fixed_pair_recipe.training_or_seed_stability: Fold-head agreement is observable; repeated optimization-seed test stability is unavailable

triage.scope: Evidence triage, not ground-truth correctness or calibrated error probability; never used for prediction routing
triage.HIGH_CONFIDENCE: Certified unanimous retrieval, or non-retrieval current/pair/E2V/XLSR class agreement with current and pair top probability >= 0.80, margins >= 0.50 and both families' five-head modal vote fractions >= 0.80
triage.HARD: Non-retrieval and any: current or pair top probability < 0.60; current or pair margin < 0.20; current/pair class disagreement; E2V/XLSR class disagreement; either family's modal head vote fraction < 0.80
triage.threshold_selection: Fixed before computing test case summaries; no threshold search or public/protected-score tuning
triage.semantic_handling: Qwen hard labels and unclear abstentions are separate evidence; do not invent probabilities or use semantic disagreement as a routing/triage veto

neighbors.metric: Cosine similarity on each existing raw cached mean+std representation, separately for emotion2vec and XLS-R; deterministic ID tie-break
neighbors.meaning: Descriptive representation neighbors, not certified duplicates, speaker identities or new test labels

speaker_evidence: Existing strict ECAPA agglomerative assignments at distance 0.10/0.15 only; co-clustering is auxiliary evidence, not verified speaker identity
ASR_quality_flags: Empty transcript, detected language other than hi, language_probability < 0.80, avg_logprob < -1.0, no_speech_prob > 0.50 or compression_ratio > 2.40; descriptive flags, not validation authority
scientific_comparison: Recompute the existing ordinary V-B OOF aggregate/fold/class metrics and paired corrections/breakages without changing folds; no historical validation redesign
missing_evidence: Leave unavailable AST test probabilities, semantic probability vectors, seed stability and source/speaker ground truth empty with explicit reasons
submission_authorization: Not granted; prepare and audit only
